summary: Frontend-only regression at 390x844 covering ALL 8 targeted flows for the LOCAL BACKUPS + WhatsApp + autocomplete + vendors round. PASS on every check with no crashes and no console/page errors. (1) App loads, header shows 'SVKD COIR' with 'Stored on this device' status. (2) AUTOCOMPLETE: added 'Ravi Traders' (Coir Pith, 5t x ₹2000, phone 9876543210) with auto-amount = ₹10,000.00 in record-amount-input; reopened Add Income, typed 'Ra' into record-name-input -> record-name-input-suggestions container renders with 1 suggest-option; tapping the option fills the field with 'Ravi Traders'; then typed a brand-new 'New Fresh Vendor XYZ' and typing was NOT blocked. record-address-input-suggestions appears when typing 'Co'. For expenses: added 'Kumar Salary' ₹5000, reopened Add Expense, typed 'Kum' into record-description-input -> record-description-input-suggestions renders and tapping the option fills 'Kumar Salary'. (3) NEW PHONE FIELD: record-phone-input accepts '9876543210' and does not break save; income tons×cost auto-computes 10000.00; amount-mode-toggle switches between AUTO<->MANUAL and back without breakage. (4) VENDORS: Settings > open-vendors-button opens vendors-modal; two vendor-row entries render — 'Ravi Traders' with vendor-income '+ ₹10,000.00' and vendor-expense '− ₹0.00' Net ₹10,000.00; 'Kumar Salary' with vendor-income '+ ₹0.00' and vendor-expense '− ₹5,000.00' Net −₹5,000.00 (confirms income names AND expense descriptions both appear as vendors). (5) LOCAL BACKUPS: Settings > open-backups-button opens local-backups-modal; create-backup-button adds a local-backup-row (count 0->1->2 on two taps); backup-restore-button opens confirm-dialog and completes restore on accept; backup-delete-button removes a snapshot (count 2->1). (6) WHATSAPP SHARE: Settings > open-customers-button lists 1 customer with customer-whatsapp-button; tapping it did not crash the app (attempts to open wa.me URL — treated as browser navigation on web). Reminders reminder-whatsapp button is code-verified (line 876) and dispatched via Linking.openURL with wa.me fallback; the button renders inside reminders-modal ONLY for records that exceed overdueDays (default 15). Reminders modal opens correctly, shows the OLDER-THAN chips (7/15/30/60 days) and 'Nothing overdue' state when nothing is >= threshold — session-created records are 0 days old so the WA button was not renderable in this run; verified in source. (7) 'Record' quick button on reminder rows is REMOVED (0 elements with testID reminder-record); reminder-open-payment still opens the payment modal in the earlier part-payment flow. (8) REGRESSION SUITE ALL GREEN: pending record shows badge PENDING and outstanding-pill; income-status-toggle opens payment-modal; payment-add-button ₹4,000 reduces payment-due from ₹10,000.00 -> ₹6,000.00; payment-settle-button drives due to ₹0.00 and badge to PAID; Calendar Month view shows product-insights + export-month-button; calendar-mode-year renders yearly-overview; calendar-day-row opens day-detail-modal; data persists across full page reload (dashboard-total-income = ₹10,000.00 after reload). No page errors, no console errors, no red-screen at any point.
action_items: REFACTOR (P1, carried from iterations 6-7): /app/frontend/app/index.tsx is now 1486 lines (up from 1295). Split into components/ (RecordForm, SuggestInput, PaymentModal, CalendarView, YearOverview, DayDetailModal, RemindersModal, CustomersModal, VendorsModal, LocalBackupsModal, Settings, Ledger, Filters, ConfirmModal, DatePickerModal, ProductInsights) and utils/pdf.ts + utils/wa.ts. Non-blocking.

MINOR UX (P3): The reminders modal's minimum overdue-days chip is 7 days. Consider adding an 'All pending' or '0 days' option so users can browse ALL pending dues from the reminders sheet (currently only reachable via the Income ledger badge). Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx overdueDays default & chips.

SECURITY (P2, carried): sanitizeIncome coerces amount via Number() but does not clamp negatives or reconcile payments[] sum against record amount on backup restore (both file restore and new local restoreBackup path — the local snapshot is trusted since it is device-authored, but a defense-in-depth clamp would be prudent). Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:35-58, 128.
critical_code_review_comments: SuggestInput (line 317) correctly filters by q, hides current exact match, caps at 5, uses onBlur setTimeout(180) so a suggest-option tap fires before blur closes the list — solid UX.

VendorsModal (line 1165) aggregates by trimmed name (fallback 'Unnamed'), sums income & expense per key, sorts by combined activity. Good. Consider skipping the aggregation for empty names entirely to avoid an 'Unnamed' bucket cluttering the sheet.

Local backups: createBackup caps history at 30 snapshots (slice(0,30)) — good bound. restoreBackup replaces incomes/expenses wholesale and closes the sheet; wrapped in requestConfirm at the row level — correct UX.
openWhatsApp gracefully falls back from primary URL to wa.me/?text= via try/catch — no unhandled promise rejections observed at runtime.
waDigits normalises 10-digit local numbers by prefixing '91' — India-appropriate default. If the app is ever localised, this needs a configurable country code.
File size: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx is 1486 lines (>700 threshold). Refactor pending (carried).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 8 targeted flows + full regression pass; only reminder-whatsapp button in-DOM was not exercised because same-day records are below the 7-day overdue threshold — verified in source)
